comment: Which milestone of BUILD.md owes each clause of the specifications and each kind of test-vector case. `completed` lists the milestones that are done. `pnpm spec:coverage` fails if a clause owed by a completed milestone has no passing test that cites it, or if a vector case owed by one is still pending. A clause is matched by its own ID, then by its section, then by its document. A clause with parts in several milestones is owed by the last of them; earlier milestones test it in part. `informative` lists the clauses that state no requirement, each with the reason; every other clause is gated, whether or not it contains a BCP 14 key word, because most of the verification algorithms are written without one.

informative.core 12: Security considerations: a summary of rules stated, and tested, elsewhere.
